## TRA Timeline

#### IPO formation and TRA execution

- 2026-03-24: Initial S-1 describes the planned TRA narratively; counterparty named as Arcline Investment Management, L.P.
- 2026-04-08: S-1/A Amendment No. 1 first attaches the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.7 and substitutes Arcline Arxis Advisory I, L.P. as the counterparty SPV
- 2026-04-16: Executed TRA dated April 16, 2026
- 2026-04-17: IPO closes; 8-K files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.5

## Explanation

Arxis is a newly-public Delaware corporation that combined four Arcline-affiliated portfolio companies under a single PubCo and completed its IPO on April 17, 2026. Concurrent with the IPO, Arxis executed a Tax Receivable Agreement with Arcline Arxis Advisory I, L.P. (a newly formed sponsor SPV) obligating it to pay 85% of cash tax savings realized from a Section 162 compensation deduction generated by Arxis's issuance of one share of Convertible Common Stock to the SPV as consideration for services under the Amended and Restated Advisory and Consulting Services Agreement. Payments are due 125 days after the relevant federal tax return is filed, with early termination available on board election or termination of the underlying services agreement. The contract is in force as of the latest available filing; no post-IPO periodic disclosure exists yet. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
